hypothesis: Last-position-only causal generation needs all-layer KV for all prompt tokens, but only the final query/output/MLP and vocabulary projection of the final block. Removing unused positions can reduce prefill work. Different GPU shapes may change rounding and greedy outputs; mathematical dependency equivalence is not bitwise equivalence.

arm_definitions.full: Pinned MLX Qwen Model on whole input, consume last logits only.
arm_definitions.head_only: Run entire decoder, slice last hidden before tied output projection; established logits_to_keep mechanism.
arm_definitions.split_last: Run first N-1 tokens and evaluate only KV; then run final token with standard model. Strong demand-aware baseline. N=1 uses standard model.
arm_definitions.final_query: First 23 blocks unchanged; last block computes all-token K/V but only last-position Q, attention output, residual/MLP and final norm/head. All decode calls use standard one-token model.

supported_scope: Qwen2.5-0.5B Q8, batch1 unpadded causal inference, ordinary floating KV, no sliding window, no external attention mask or input embeddings. Experimental opt-in only.

quality.status: previously consumed public reproduction cohort, no new quality confirmation

audit.dtype: actual local Q8 model activations; logical cache shape and elementwise equality checked for head_only and final_query vs full
audit.logits: store finite full-vocabulary max-absolute/RMS/relative-L2 error, top1, full logits SHA256 and reference top1/top2 margin; no tensor parameter serialization

synthetic_bodies: The observatory records telescope positions, calibration dates, star coordinates and exposure schedules.
The workshop records robot inspections, battery measurements, room numbers and component replacements.
benchmark.timing: Pre-tokenized/evaluated input and fresh KV objects before timer; synchronized first output token is TTFT; 31 further synchronized token intervals are decode. Complete 32-token model compute includes both. Excludes load/tokenization/network/queue/JSON. No prefix reuse across requests. Each input is whole within pinned upstream default 2048 chunk limit.
benchmark.memory: reset MLX peak after model/inputs ready; report peak active and pre-call active separately, do not add unified-memory counters. Includes whole 32-token request.
benchmark.stop_rule: Exactly one fixed study, no worker timing pre-runs, no threshold/input/variant changes after results. Record negative results. Functional/model audits contain no performance claims.
benchmark.aggregation: Per length and arm, first take median of the two request TTFT (or decode/total seconds) within each round, then median of the four round values. Speedup is control aggregate divided by candidate aggregate. Faster rounds compare the two same-round request medians. Memory aggregates use the same median-of-round-medians, and raw per-request values are retained.
benchmark.input_construction: For each body, repeat exactly 600 times; tok.encode(add_special_tokens=False), take first length tokens. No suffix or chat template for synthetic shape workload. Audit uses body0 first length tokens; prior cache uses body1 first17 tokens when specified.

acceptance.failure_behavior: Keep candidate experimental and preserve failure. Do not choose another arm as a newly accepted optimization using the same results.

attribution: Qwen weights/architecture and MLX quantization/attention kernels are upstream.
Head-only projection is established logits_to_keep behavior; no novelty claim.
Project work is demand-dependency analysis, guarded graph-level implementation and controlled mechanism/rounding/cost evidence.
publication: New draft PR permitted; no automatic merge, tag or release for this new node.
